node.statement: By node 1.2, p_{u_r} = sum_i beta_r(i)*p_i. By the chart-coordinate definition recorded in node 1.3.1, each p_i = sum_q a_q(i)*p_{u_q}. Substitution gives p_{u_r} = sum_i beta_r(i)*(sum_q a_q(i)*p_{u_q}); since the row-index set and {0,1,2} are finite, bilinearity of scalar multiplication and addition permits distributing beta_r(i) and interchanging the finite sums, yielding p_{u_r} = sum_q (sum_i beta_r(i)*a_q(i))*p_{u_q}.
